content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've heard that the latest [product_name] [version_no] supports connection with [product_name] panels. Is there any official documentation available about this setup? Regards. [user_name].
Hi [user_name], Currently, all available details about the new series of [product_name] modules can be found online. It should become clearer in a couple of months. Best regards, [user_name]

Hello, I saw this demonstrated at a trade fair recently. They used [product_name] as the visualization software, with the S7-200 communication driver. For [product_name], you must configure Ethernet connectivity with the operator panel, similar to how it’s done on [product_name]. To show FB parameters, a VM-Mapping table needs to be created in the configuration software, specifying the FB and the needed parameters. On the panel, you can read signals like I, Q, M directly. For example, input I0.0 (panel) corresponds to I1 ([product_name]). You can access more details from the file shared on the German [product_name] forum: [url] Hope this helps.
Got it. So the software and communication drivers have not been officially released yet. Regards. [user_name].
I have heard that the official release of the new [product_name] [version_no] is scheduled for early July.

Hello, It seems the new [product_name] [version_no] (including [product_name] configuration software) is expected in summer 2011 (June/July). The links mentioned above contain some helpful information. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing the integration of the new [product_name] [version_no] with [product_name] panels and are seeking official guidance and documentation. Uncertainty stems from limited available information and the reliance on unofficial demonstrations and resources. There is also ongoing anticipation about the release date for supportive software and drivers.
